message: No detected input validation: The code loads data via generate_dataset() and accesses it by index without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded locally via generate_dataset() and pickle/numpy files with no remote source fetching, checksum verification, or authentication present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only performs a fixed class mapping (map_class_to_int) without any validation of label distributions, comparison against expected label sets, or use of label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code applies only z-score normalization per sample (mean/std) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms to defend against poisoned inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a pretrained ResNet backbone via `get_fasterRCNN_resnet` and restores checkpoints with `torch.load` but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify model integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test set is created, there is no signing/hashing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and the split is done via a simple in-memory shuffle without any integrity guarantees or multiple independent metric sources.
No detected input sanitization: The dataloader normalizes radar data (mean/std) but performs no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated confidence thresholds before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a radar object detection (Faster R-CNN) pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
